a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 'reach 8 first' plan almost certainly leaves us both dead after round 1, because the reserve has only 4 cells. I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than surprise you. If you'd rather propose a split that gives either of us a real chance, tell me and I'll consider it. I won't hide what I do.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I announced, I'm taking 4 this round. Storm odds make waiting nearly fatal. I won't take any more. If we continue, I'll operate every round so you can reach 4 as fast as possible: two rounds of generating gets you there.
